text:
michelle: Kicking off Lynx EAP onboarding thread — quick sync. @andre, can you confirm NDA countersigned and where you uploaded it?
andre (lynx-hw): NDA signed by both sides, uploaded to partner S3: https://lynx-partner.s3.amazonaws.com/nda/lynx-redwood-signed.pdf
michelle: great. we have sample devkit shipping to our lab today. kevin, once kit lands can you prioritize the perf smoke?
kevin (bench): yes. plan is: inventory, flash image, run quick perf (5 runs) then full matrix. should be able to start within 6h of arrival.
dan (eng-ml): FYI we need the exact driver/kernel combo. ask Lynx for kernel v5.15+ bundle and the RK libs. otherwise quant path might regress.
andre (lynx-hw): sending a tarball to the secure bucket: lynx/devkit/1991054320/driver_bundle_v0.9.4.tar.gz. includes kernel patches and release notes.
sara (legal): small flag: clause 3.2 allows sharing intermediate logs with partners pre-announcement, but public release needs joint approval. will review the PRD.
michelle: noted. public communication must be coordinated. marketing/james — do you want to be looped now for joint blog timelines?
james (product): yes please. if benchmarks look good we'd aim for a gated co-announcement ~2 weeks after final report. marketing needs 48h to draft.
kevin (bench): test matrix (high level): throughput, p99 latency, mem usage, quantized int8/q4 variants, 2K and 4K context. dataset = common-bench v2.1 + synthetic prompts (no PII).
dan: add kv-cache stress and prefix-caching tests. also run with continuous batching toggles. recommend: `--kv-cache on` and `--batcher=adaptive` for one run.
kevin (bench): example run command:
```
./run_bench.sh --model redwood/rt-13b --image lynx-v0.9.4 --batch 8 --seq 2048 --quant q4_0 --kv-cache on
```
kevin (bench): CI note: will upload logs to s3://redwood-logs/lynx/1991054320/ after each run. link will be included in final report.
ci-bot: scheduled job nightly-bench #6542 (owner: @kevin) — will run additional long-run overnight.
kevin (bench): quick hiccup: flash succeeded but we saw one OOM on node-3 during step 3. collecting dmesg + perf counters, uploading now.
dan (eng-ml): attach dmesg and the driver logs. looks like memory accounting wasn't applied for the RK allocator in v0.9.2 — v0.9.4 patch should fix.
andre (lynx-hw): rolling v0.9.4 to the unit set in the lab now (hotpatch). ETA ~90m. will also rotate the VM creds after patch.
michelle: timeline check: device out today, bench runs Thu-Fri, draft report Monday. legal review + marketing draft Tue. does that align with everyone's capacity?
esara?
sara (legal): 48h turnaround on copy review once marketing posts draft. fine.
james (product): marketing booking OK. want to run joint QA session Wed AM with Lynx for messaging.
kevin (bench): action items: collect perf plots + raw logs; tag interesting regressions; attach run commands and env.yml (images, driver sha).
dan (eng-ml): I'll validate patch on a mirrored run once Andre finishes hotpatch. will post diff and a short repro.
andre (lynx-hw): will also provide a VPN jumpbox and temporary user creds via Secrets Manager. note: these creds expire in 7 days — will extend if needed.
michelle: small ask for telemetry: please include per-token latency histograms + kernel CPU usage. that'll help Optimize team give batching recs.
kevin (bench): will include p50/p90/p99 histo + kernel uptime graphs. naming convention: lynx_1991054320_{runid}.png
michelle: thanks. final: keep partner-visible logs in the partner bucket until marketing/legal sign-off. public artifacts should be a cleaned summary and reproducible script only.
andre (lynx-hw): agreed. thanks team. ping me for any infra creds.
michelle: assigning actions: @kevin collect & upload all artifacts; @dan validate patch & post repro; @sara review NDA+release clause; @james draft marketing outline; @andre coordinate creds & patch. back of napkin ETA = 10 days for public go/no-go.
michelle: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
